question.text:
An ‘Assertion’ and a ‘Reason’ is given below. Choose the correct answer from the following options:
Assertion A: Vinyl halides do not undergo nucleophilic substitution easily.
Reason R: Even though the intermediate carbocation is stabilized by loosely held π- electrons, the cleavage is difficult because of the strong bonding.

options.text: Both <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> are correct statements but <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is not the correct explanation of <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math>

Both <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> are wrong statements and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>)</mo></math> is the correct explanation of <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>.</mo></math>

<math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is a correct statement but <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is a wrong statement.

solution.text: <math><msub><mrow><mtext>CH</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math> does not undergo unimolecular nucleophilic substitution <math><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>)</mo></math> reaction due to the formation of highly unstable cation <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mover><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>⊕</mo></mrow></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo></math> which can not be delocalized by <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mo>-</mo></math> electrons. It does not give <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> because <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> cloud is exposed, so, hindrance is there.
